The '''Dolstan system''' was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], within the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]]. It was governed by the [[Pimbrellan League]] and contained the planet [[Dolstan]].
